findings.text: The fragment states every arm is a batch job on all_debug launched with SLURM_JOB_ID unset, but head-gate.log line 4 records the job id 1328670 on 98dci4-clu-3141.iter.org, so the measured pytest process ran with SLURM_JOB_ID set: the arm script prints that value from the measured job's own environment and never unsets it before the measured command, where the sibling idiom runs the measured command under env -u SLURM_JOB_ID. The done_when clause is therefore unverified and the landed evidence asserts a condition that did not hold. Non-blocking because neither reckon/_worker_fence.py nor reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py reads SLURM_JOB_ID, so the path under test is unaffected and both arms were measured under the same condition.

The added pin of NODE_TMP_ROOT and node_tmp_runtime_paths carries no assertion of its own, so its regression is visible only where the ambient pytest tmp root falls under NODE_TMP_ROOT: the base arm at 5b0a1f53 reddens on this node because tmp_path sits under /tmp, but a host whose TMPDIR lies outside the node tmp would still run green with the pin removed and these added lines would be unguarded.
